system.description:
MANIPULATE

Action 1 AP

The ghoul consumes the flesh of an adjacent creature that has died within the last hour regaining 1d6 HP. The ghoul may only gain this benefit once from each body.

Use (1 AP): target an adjacent corpse that died within the last hour — regain 1d6 HP (3d6 with Greater Carrion Feast), once from each body; the body is marked so it cannot feed you twice.
